description: This source file contains unit tests for CSV file operations, including reading from and writing to CSV files, using the testing framework and assertions in Go.

methods.name: TestGenerateCSVLines
methods.description: Tests the CSV line generation function with a valid CSV file and verifies each line's column count and total lines read.

methods.name: TestNonExistentFile
methods.description: Tests error handling when attempting to generate CSV lines from a non-existent file.

methods.name: TestWriteCSVToFile
methods.description: Tests writing CSV data to a file and verifies that the CSV can be read back correctly with the expected contents.
